searches.query: GPT OR Claude OR Gemini since:2026-06-22
model release OR benchmark OR paper since:2026-06-22
Google OR Meta OR Mistral OR DeepMind announce since:2026-06-22

tweet_pool.author: OpenAI
tweet_pool.text: OpenAI expands its Daybreak program with the full version of GPT-5.5-Cyber, a Codex Security plugin to find, validate and fix vulnerabilities, a Patch the Planet effort to move open-source maintainers from findings to merged fixes, and a Cyber Partner Program.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Official OpenAI product launch; primary source corroborated by sama and gdb.

tweet_pool.author: IntCyberDigest
tweet_pool.text: Analytical reframe of the OpenAI cyber launch: the model beats Mythos on the CyberGym bug-finding benchmark, applied to the permissive exploit-capable model given to verified defenders.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Distinct third-party analysis with benchmark detail and dual-use framing.

tweet_pool.author: GoogleDeepMind
tweet_pool.text: Google DeepMind announces a research partnership with film studio A24 to build AI tools for movie production and distribution; reporting puts the figure at $75M.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Official DeepMind corporate move; $75M figure from WSJ via DiscussingFilm.

tweet_pool.author: xiaohu
tweet_pool.text: ByteDance releases upgraded Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 video models with 30-second single-pass clips, native 4K, up to 50 full-modal reference inputs and 3D white-model support, plus a new AI copyright commercialization platform.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Most detailed primary report of Seedance 2.0/2.5; corroborated by testingcatalog and LinusEkenstam.

tweet_pool.author: DataChaz
tweet_pool.text: Santander's AI Lab open-sources 11 repositories under the Apache-2.0 license, releasing internal AI infrastructure for public use.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Notable open-source release from a major bank; concrete and distinct from frontier-lab news.

tweet_pool.author: Vivek4real_
tweet_pool.text: Sam Altman is shown ChatGPT producing fabricated answers during a live on-stage demo; when repeated the model invents another reply, and when shown Altman's own comment the model states he was wrong.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely circulated on-stage event; detail corroborated by FutureWinsDaily.

tweet_pool.author: Steve8708
tweet_pool.text: Steve8708 launches Clips, a free open-source agent-native alternative to Loom; agents can parse a Clip directly from a URL through its APIs and metadata and can see and hear its contents.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete open-source product launch with an agent-native design angle.

tweet_pool.author: dair_ai
tweet_pool.text: A large LLM-as-a-Judge reliability audit runs 21 judges from nine providers across roughly 541,000 judgments on MT-Bench, JudgeBench and RewardBench, finding that exact-match agreement overstates a judge's true skill.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Substantive research summary with concrete scale and a useful methodological finding.

tweet_pool.author: nathanrs
tweet_pool.text: A developer turns Apple Notes into a Claude/ChatGPT frontend, letting any LLM API be used to chat directly inside the Notes interface.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete, low-noise practitioner build repurposing Apple Notes as an LLM client.

tweet_pool.author: iamlukethedev
tweet_pool.text: A developer reports asking the Hermes agent to install Computer Use, remotely control a machine, take a screenshot and return it, with the setup completing without manual configuration.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Fresh hands-on agent computer-use account with a concrete workflow.

tweet_pool.author: AlexFinn
tweet_pool.text: A widely shared post reports Mac Studio units selling out except the 96GB configuration, framing the demand as a signal of growing interest in running AI models locally.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Local-AI demand signal with solid engagement; distinct hardware angle.

tweet_pool.author: sama
tweet_pool.text: Full GPT-5.5-Cyber here; SOTA on CyberGym. Patch The Planet and Codex Security solve problems, not just find them.

tweet_pool.author: gdb
tweet_pool.text: Models discovering and generating patches for critical vulns in browsers, network infra, and OSes like FreeBSD and Linux.

tweet_pool.author: DiscussingFilm
tweet_pool.text: Google investing $75M into A24 in an AI research partnership for movie tools (WSJ).

tweet_pool.author: 0xMovez
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic engineers showed agentic systems running for days using loops; >30% of Anthropic code written by loops.

tweet_pool.author: arcane_bloom
tweet_pool.text: ML/LLM study resources from a job-search blog, including Stanford CS336 Language Modelling from Scratch.

tweet_pool.author: SakanaAILabs
tweet_pool.text: Sakana Fugu multi-agent orchestration; Fugu Ultra matches Fable and Mythos.
